brand_identity.name: Prayan
brand_identity.positioning: Premium, mobile-first AI-powered Dubai real estate search and advisory concierge.
brand_identity.aesthetic: Light soft-white architectural editorial layout, large rounded-corner photo panels, thin vertical divider-lined feature columns, soft edges, restrained shadows, subtle geometric details, and high-trust editorial elegance.
anti_patterns: Do NOT create a dark sci-fi neon AI grid look
Do NOT use generic blue SaaS templates or default Vercel design
Do NOT center-align body copy paragraphs or list items
Do NOT use transparent popovers or translucent overlays without proper fallback opacity

rules: Warm Orange (#FF7A38) is strictly reserved for selected action highlights, badge accents, and small detail focus indicators.
Main visual identity rests on Midnight Blue (#102B4D), Sapphire Blue (#245DCC), and Soft White (#F7F9FC).
Ensure all interactive text states explicitly set text colors (e.g. hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white).

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-[1.1]
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#102B4D]
hierarchy.caption: text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium tracking-wider uppercase text-[#245DCC]

icons.rules: Use Lucide icons strictly with uniform stroke width. Never mix emoji characters as interface icons.

layout_and_grid.spacing_philosophy: Generous architectural whitespace, 2-3x typical density for marketing components (py-16 to py-28 for sections).

grid_structure.feature_columns: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 divide-y md:divide-y-0 md:divide-x divide-slate-200 gap-6

layout_and_grid.rounded_corners: Use large rounded architectural frames: rounded-3xl (24px) for main image panels and hero cards, rounded-2xl for property cards, rounded-full for action pills.

pages_to_implement.name: Home
pages_to_implement.description: Full-width architectural hero with semi-transparent AI lead enquiry card ('Let's find what fits.'), multi-step follow-up form, featured properties, architectural benefits, 4-step customer journey, AI assistant intro banner, FAQ accordion, and floating AI chat button.

pages_to_implement.name: Explore Properties
pages_to_implement.description: Property catalog with live filter bar (location, property type, price range, bedrooms, status search), grid/map layout toggle, property cards, and sorting options.

pages_to_implement.name: Property Details
pages_to_implement.description: Immersive image gallery, specs breakdown, interactive Dubai location details, curated luxury amenities, pricing calculator/breakdown, and direct enquiry/viewing request CTAs.

pages_to_implement.name: How It Works
pages_to_implement.description: Visual breakdown of Prayan's AI property matching mechanism, concierge agent support, verified property listings, and end-to-end buying process.

pages_to_implement.name: Contact
pages_to_implement.description: Direct contact form, Dubai office addresses (Downtown Dubai & Palm Jumeirah), concierge hotline, and quick AI enquiry trigger.

pages_to_implement.name: Owner Dashboard
pages_to_implement.description: Protected admin dashboard showing lead metrics, new enquiries, pending follow-ups, viewing requests, detailed enquiry drawer, and AI-generated editable follow-up message generator with instant copy button.

pages_to_implement.name: Privacy Policy
pages_to_implement.description: Clean editorial legal document regarding data usage, AI lead consent, and UAE privacy standards.

pages_to_implement.name: Terms of Service
pages_to_implement.description: Terms governing property enquiries, advisory services, and platform usage.

shared: Header with sticky glassmorphism backdrop (bg-[#F7F9FC]/90 backdrop-blur-md), centered nav links, and pill CTA ('Talk to Prayan')
Mobile Navigation Drawer with smooth toggle and accessible action shortcuts
Hero AI Lead Form Card ('Let's find what fits.') with multi-step flow (Type/Location/Budget -> Contact -> Consent -> Confirmation)
Property Card with large rounded photos, price badge, location label, key specs (Beds/Baths/Sqft), and 'Request a Viewing' pill CTA
Floating AI Chat Widget ('Talk to Prayan') with interactive quick-prompt questions and real-time response simulator
Owner Dashboard Lead Table & AI Follow-Up Message Editor with tone selection and copy-to-clipboard button
FAQ Accordion with smooth height transitions and clear response typography
Footer with newsletter subscription form, quick site links, legal disclaimers, and social links
Consent Control Modal/Checkbox compliant with UAE lead preferences

testing_requirements.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, filters, tabs, lead steps, chat toggles, modal triggers, copy buttons) MUST include unambiguous kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-lead-submit-button', data-testid='property-card-view-details-1', data-testid='ai-followup-copy-btn').

motion_and_accessibility.animations: Subtle framer-motion or CSS transitions for tab switches, drawer reveals, and step transitions.
motion_and_accessibility.reduced_motion: Wrap non-essential motion in prefers-reduced-motion checks.
motion_and_accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA / WCAG 4.5:1 text contrast for body copy and 3:1 for interactive elements against background surfaces.
